summary: Master the essentials of investment banking with our comprehensive training course. Equip yourself with the skills needed for a successful finance career.
lede: Investment banking involves advising on transactions, raising capital and analyzing company value. The training is for junior analysts and other finance professionals who need to assess companies and support deal work. It covers integrated financial modeling, DCF and comparable-company valuation, and structuring mergers, acquisitions and capital-raising transactions.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals who require a practitioner-level understanding of deal mechanics and financial valuation to advance their careers in high-stakes finance.
audience: Equity Research Analysts focused on fundamental company
modules: Investment Banking Ecosystem and Deal Lifecycle
Advanced Financial Statement Analysis and Modeling
Trading Comparables and Precedent Transaction Analysis
Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) and WACC Analysis
Pitching, AI Integration, and Strategic Reporting
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of accounting principles (balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow) and intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP, IF statements, and basic financial functions). No prior investment banking experience is required, but familiarity with corporate finance concepts is highly recommended.
